features.title: Toggle the sidebar with the platform primary chord
features.summary: Capture primary+B in the browser capture phase, prevent competing shell handling, and choose Meta on Mac or Control elsewhere.
failureModes: Modifier mismatch leaves the browser and Host behavior untouched.
A missing layout service is surfaced rather than silently swallowed.

verification.testName: resolves primary to Meta on macOS and Control elsewhere
refuses a chord carrying an extra modifier
claims a matching chord before bubble listeners see it
leaves events alone that someone else already handled or that repeat

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Toggle the sidebar with the platform primary chord renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Select native panels with keyboard shortcuts
features.summary: Use primary+N and primary+comma to select the declared panel target while respecting editable fields, IME composition, repeat, and prior event claims.
failureModes: Extra Alt or Shift modifiers do not trigger a shortcut.

verification.testName: accepts text fields and editable regions, refuses buttons and checkboxes

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Select native panels with keyboard shortcuts renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Rebindable command keys
features.summary: Binds every dshx Command on the keys it answers to now: its default keys, or the binding the user chose in the Host's Keyboard shortcuts dialog for an editable command. Editable commands are listed there without a default binding, and page-scoped commands keep their keys off inside text fields.
failureModes: A command whose id has no Host shortcut form stays unlisted with a console warning and keeps its default keys.
A binding with modifiers other than Mod and Shift stays unbound with a console warning.

verification.testName: lists only editable commands, unbound, under their Host id, and passes key presses back to the capture listener

telemetry.reason: Client-only: key bindings and the Host shortcut registry live in the browser and start no Host work.
